q: Which of these does NOT make y a function of x?
why: From x = y², x = 4 gives y = 2 or y = −2. A function gives exactly one output for each input.

q: f(x) = 2x + 1 and g(x) = x². Find f(g(3)).
why: Composition feeds g's output into f: f(g(3)) = f(9) = 19.
